S2's "Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ 11.58 sec" is SKIPPED because it rides the lethal-damage trigger, which is unreachable at scope lock — it is the one skipped line that would materially move damage (a shortened burst cycle) if it ever fired.
⚑ Base SMG cadence (rate_of_fire, reloadFrames 111) is datamine-sourced and unverified; the value of the Reload Speed buff scales directly with it.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Makima (SMG/Water/Defender/Burst II) is a pure sustain/aggro kit: no damage rider, no ATK/crit/core buff, no boss debuff. The only damage-relevant line in the whole kit is S1's team-wide Reload Speed ▲ 36.96% / 10s — reload speed gates shots fired, so it is NOT skippable — and its trigger ("attacked 20 times") has no engine representation, so it is approximated as ⚑ interval 15s. S1 DEF ▲ 14.78% is kept as a stat buff though defPct is offensively inert in v1. Burst = self Pierce as a timed gainPierce effect (10s window; deliberately NOT the whole-fight hasPierce flag) plus the self lifesteal recorded as a 10-tick heal so any on-recovery consumer would see the events. S2 is entirely unreachable at scope lock: the taunt has no aggro model, and both the indomitability window and the Burst-CD ▼ 11.58s ride "when taking lethal damage" (nobody takes damage in v1), which in turn leaves the burst's indomitability-gated Incoming Healing ▲ dead.
